verdict.rationale: Ultrametric is a hosted service that stores company records on its own servers, so data residency is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows no option to choose a storage region. The only selectable setting is `--environment` (production or staging), which is a deployment environment rather than a region. Some local-only behaviour is documented (`--path` context stays local, offline schema-validated record stores), but it is not a residency choice for the hosted data.
